country_event = {
	id = zin_west.65
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		# The boats come in: every seven days the armies standing in an evacuation port sail home.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_evacuation NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_evacuated } }
			1081 = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_state_flag = zin_west_evacuation_port }
					teleport_armies = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged } }
				}
			}
			685 = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_state_flag = zin_west_evacuation_port }
					teleport_armies = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged } }
				}
			}
